claims.sourceText: Robert Sheaffer interviews with Randle, Skeptical Inquirer
claims.text: Randle told Skeptical Inquirer that he is 'getting more skeptical in my old age', that he sets 'a very high bar for the level of evidence required', and later that he is no longer sure what happened at Roswell and the case for extraterrestrial involvement is no longer robust.

title: Robert Sheaffer interviews with Randle, Skeptical Inquirer

topics.title: Civilian research groups and the disclosure movement
Official explanations: Mogul, balloons, flares and misidentification
